user.title: Scene Studio
user.description: Set up Scene Studio. Scenes, presets and the room card are configured in the Scene Studio panel afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Scene Studio is already set up. Only a single instance is possible.

apply_preset.name: Apply preset
apply_preset.description: Apply a scene preset to specified light entities

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: What to apply the preset to

smart_shuffle.name: Smart shuffle
smart_shuffle.description: Ensure smooth color transitions when shuffling

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: Optional. Lights to leave out, e.g. when targeting a whole area. Excluding a group also excludes its members.

keep_groups.name: Keep groups
keep_groups.description: Optional. Light groups that are controlled as one light (all members get the same color) instead of light by light.

optional.name: Optional lights
optional.description: Optional. Lights that take part only if they are on when the scene starts. If one is turned on later while the scene is active, it joins the scene.

light_brightness.name: Brightness per light
light_brightness.description: Optional. Brightness in percent (0-100) for single lights, e.g. light.led_strip: 20. Overrides the scene brightness for these lights; 0 turns the light off when the scene starts. A value for a group also applies to its lights.

gradient.name: Gradient lamps
gradient.description: Optional, default true. Gradient lamps (e.g. Hue Signe or Play gradient in Zigbee2MQTT) show all colors of the preset as a gradient. false: one color like any other lamp.

saturation.name: Color intensity
saturation.description: Optional, -100 to 100, default 0. Positive values make the colors of the preset more vivid, negative values paler (towards white). The hue stays.

get_dynamic_scenes.name: Get dynamic scenes
get_dynamic_scenes.description: Get all currently active dynamic scenes

start_dynamic_scene.name: Start dynamic scene
start_dynamic_scene.description: Start a loop that periodically applies a shuffled scene preset

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: What to apply the preset to

interval_min.name: Interval min (per light)
interval_min.description: Optional. Enables per-light timing: each light waits a random time between min and max before its next color change

interval_max.name: Interval max (per light)
interval_max.description: Optional. Upper bound of the random per-light interval

transition_min.name: Transition min (per light)
transition_min.description: Optional. Enables per-light timing: each color change uses a random transition between min and max

transition_max.name: Transition max (per light)
transition_max.description: Optional. Upper bound of the random per-light transition

stop_dynamic_scene.name: Stop dynamic scene
stop_dynamic_scene.description: Stop a dynamic scene by ID

id.name: ID
id.description: The UUID of the dynamic scene to stop

stop_dynamic_scenes_for_targets.name: Stop dynamic scenes for targets
stop_dynamic_scenes_for_targets.description: Stops all dynamic scenes that include any of the specified targets

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Targets to stop all dynamic scenes for

stop_all_dynamic_scenes.name: Stop all dynamic scenes
stop_all_dynamic_scenes.description: Stops all currently running dynamic scenes

save_scene.description: Save a preset together with targets and settings as a reusable scene. Creates a scene entity.

id.description: Optional. ID of an existing saved scene to overwrite

music.name: Music scene
music.description: Optional. Makes this a music scene: the colors come from the album cover of the media player (media_player: an entity, or "any" for whichever speaker is playing), the preset is used until a cover is known. auto_start: never (only when selected), follow (when music starts while a music scene is active in another room) or always. By default it starts by itself only if no light of the scene is on; when_on: true starts it anyway.

saturation.name: Color intensity
saturation.description: Optional, -100 to 100, default 0. Positive values make the colors of the preset more vivid, negative values paler (towards white). The hue stays.

delete_saved_scene.name: Delete saved scene
delete_saved_scene.description: Delete a saved scene and its scene entity

activate_saved_scene.name: Activate saved scene
activate_saved_scene.description: Activate a saved scene (same as turning on its scene entity)

dynamic.name: Dynamic
dynamic.description: Optional. Override the saved mode: off applies a dynamic scene once (static), on starts a static scene as dynamic scene

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Optional. Apply the saved scene to these lights instead of its own targets (exclude, keep_groups and optional are ignored then). The lights leave running dynamic scenes, the rest of those scenes keeps going.

import_scene_presets.name: Import from Scene Presets
import_scene_presets.description: Brings saved scenes, own presets and replaced pictures over from the Scene Presets integration. Scenes that were imported before are skipped.

take_over_entities.name: Take over scene entities
take_over_entities.description: Keep entity ID, name, area and labels of the scene entities, so dashboards and automations keep working. Scene Presets is disabled for that (not removed).

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Import scenes and files again even if they exist already.
